to remember their dead. any group yet to confirm a date with the parish should do so this week. christmas shoebox appeal. the response to our christmas shoebox appeal has been very encouraging. when a person has completed their shoebox, they can return them to the parish. returned shoeboxes are sent to children affected by poverty in countries in africa and eastern europe. the closing date to ensure that boxes will reach their intended locations is nov 10th so that children can enjoy their gifts for christmas. scan the qr code to view a joyous video on how the shoebox appeal is helping and bringing hope to children affected by poverty worldwide. think about it: getting older, growing wiser. people you love will die. you will mourn them and miss them terribly. but you will not honour them by dying before your time. you are still connected with them in memory and spirit. let this connection inspire and strengthen you for living. a memory of days gone by: an sma priest who spent many years with us here in wilton was fr. tom kearney. one of fr. tom’s great contributions to the parish was to introduce us to aquaponics. scan the qr code and fr. tom will explain to us the story of the introduction of aquaponics to wilton parish. a very interesting story. you will enjoy it! feast of all saints (cycle today’s feast of all saints invites us to celebrate our own folk, to take pride in the saints who have preceded us and who grace our community. to celebrate with pride is not to be triumphalistic; we can admit the horror stories while still being proud of the numberless people who have remained stubbornly open to the spirit. we rejoice in the saints we have known and know: their names are legion. we bless the lord for those who attend to the hungry, the orphans, the aged, the outcasts, the overlooked. we thank god for those who have out smiled the jibes and taunts of oppressors, for those whose whispered prayers have enriched the holiness of us all. we express our gratitude for those who confront religious pretence, for those who keep on forgiving with an energy that is worthy of god. for all those people, among us still, we give thanks. and if you feel thanked in the process, don’t feel confused. you’re lucky to be part of the same crowd . sacred space and the living faith. copies of sacred space 2026 for advent and christmas are on sale in the mass
